description.zh: 联盟描述，可以选填，如需填写，限制在1~255个字符。
description.en: The description of the consortium. This parameter is optional. If specified, the description must be 1 to 255 characters in length.

description.zh: 联盟名称，只能是英文大小写、数字、中文字符、短划线（-）的自由组合，不能有空格或特殊字符，限制1~100个字符。
description.en: The name of the consortium. The name can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, and hyphens (-). The name cannot contain spaces or special characters. The name must be 1 to 100 characters in length.
